title: Contracts as forum contacts
summary: A contract can create forum connections through the parties’ deliberate relationship, negotiations, future obligations, and performance. The existence of a contract with a forum resident is only part of the inquiry.
notes: Burger King does not hold that every interstate contract creates jurisdiction wherever the other party resides. Its sustained franchise relationship and other connections explain the result.

sections.Meaning: A contract can create forum connections through the parties’ deliberate relationship, negotiations, future obligations, and performance. The existence of a contract with a forum resident is only part of the inquiry.
sections.How to work through the question: Read the prior negotiations, contemplated consequences, agreement, and actual course of dealing. Identify which connections the defendant created. Distinguish a choice-of-law term from an agreement selecting a court or consenting to jurisdiction.
